reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was Magnesium, 200 mg, 30 sachets and the QR line, and the QR report is a nice touch, but I already reorder a magnesium that works for me and I look for an NSF or USP seal, which I don't see here.
objection: A brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A QR to its own lab report is not the same as a third-party certification I already trust, and I am not going to be the one who tests a new brand when my current bottle works.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box and a few hundred honest reviews.
